title: Snowboard Hero
notes: Physical ARM64 retest on 2026-10-09 with IPA SHA-256 74efc6f5ea00502df2dfbaa243472daa013d0ee209edcbc373880b2af5761fab. The previous Career crash in native GLES1 glDrawElements stopped recurring after the emulator forwarded the four GL_OES_matrix_palette entry points on the host Adreno driver. Loading, upright menu, Career, character/challenge selection and a rendered race work. Jump and pause/resume were observed, and a sample race reached its results screen. Steering/accelerometer, audio quality, later career, saves and sustained performance remain untested. This supersedes the earlier crash report for this specific APK and build; it is not a full-game approval.
